recentItems.title: You Can See Everything - Official Teaser (2026) Nathan Fielder, Elizabeth Holmes
recentItems.description:
Don't miss this trailer for You Can See Everything, an upcoming documentary from A24, directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim. You Can See Everything is the true events of notorious Silicone Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes, 34 days before she's sent to prison, she invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. This is what they captured. 

You Can See Everything comes to cinemas this October!

recentItems.title: The latest with Teamfight Tactics at #PAXWest
FreeStyle Football 2 PAX West 2026 Booth Tour | PAX 2026
recentItems.description:
We checked out FreeStyle Football 2 at PAX West 2026! In this video, we tour the JOYCITY booth, play the exciting new demo, and even get a custom shirt, hot off the press. FreeStyle Football 2 is a cross-platform, 5v5 multiplayer soccer game where teamwork and character-specific FreeStyle moves turn the tide of battle. Wishlist on Steam, PS5, and Xbox today, and play it day one with Xbox Game Pass! Don't miss the Prime Open Beta this weekend. 

Presented by FreeStyle Football 2.

recentItems.title: Persona 4 Revival - Official Kanji Sizzle Trailer
recentItems.description:
Check out the Kanji Sizzle Trailer for Persona 4 Revival, a remake of the hit turn-based RPG developed by Atlus. Make way for the legendary delinquent - Kanji Tatsumi in Persona 4 Revival, launching on February 18, 2027, for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Dominik Mysterio and Penta Reveal Their GOAT Picks
recentItems.description:
WWE superstars Dominik Mysterio and Penta share their GOAT picks with IGN, answering stupid questions like their GOAT pizza topping and emoji, and also giving us thoughtful answers to things like their GOAT piece of advice and GOAT small joy that always makes life better. 
We also dig into their WWE picks for things like their favourite luchador and what they think is the best WWE match to show a newcomer.

AAA Mega champion and son of WWE legend, Rey Mysterio, Dominik Mysterio defends his title at Triplemania, but perhaps his real challenge is answering what the greatest smell of all time is.

recentItems.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker: How to Skip Straight to the Endgame & Unlock the Secret Ending
recentItems.description:
The Blood of Dawnwalker is a pretty open-ended RPG. The vampire lord Brensis and his vassals are some pretty intimidating villains, but if you’ve got the guts, you can roll right up to his castle and skip straight to the point of no return, or even seek out an alternate ending. 
Here’s how.

recentItems.title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus - Official Super Surge Trailer (English Subtitles)
recentItems.description:
Check out the latest trailer for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus! Broadcasting and streaming begins October 2026.
The God of Destruction Beerus, Frieza, and now — A new threat closing in on Earth, stands in the way of Goku and his allies. 
Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus’s overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.
Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an Earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his allies—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.
The anime Dragon Ball Super, original work, story, and character design by Akira Toriyama, is set to begin anew as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus!
